proposed_from.topic: Fix p>=2 and equally spaced times 0,h,2h,3h. Let X(t)=exp(tG)(X(0)-x*)+x* with real Hurwitz G in the principal-log alias strip, Gaussian X(0), and independent unpaired observations Y_k=X(kh)+epsilon_k with one unknown common E>0 and no process noise. Restrict to strict positive adjacent covariance decreases. Prove the complete covariance-difference orthogonal-stabilizer classification of compatible V=exp(hG), including block Gram feasibility, O(m-r) fibers, stability/logarithm/Stein/E-positivity filters, finite sign enumeration, and global uniqueness certification. Prove three snapshots have generic continuous ambiguity for p>=3 while four identify generically by a rational Krylov map; classify exceptional fibers, show exponentially many admissible explanations can occur, identify information nullity with stabilizer dimension, and derive perturbation bounds plus branchwise moment inference on regular strata. Use covar_lin_dyn as the supplied-noise consumer. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: The stabilizer/admissibility proofs and Krylov recovery were derived; exact checks passed 105 legal models/relabelings, four p=3 rotations preserving three snapshots, a four-snapshot continuous fiber, a two-model finite fiber, the supplied rational witness, and 60 perturbations. No matching common-noise theorem was found in Aalto, Wang, QWENDY v4, Morimoto-Kashima, or Inoue. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Construct a certified initializer and labeling rule for noncyclic finite branches with quantitative separation from excluded branches; current local residual estimators are implicit. EARLY KILL TEST: Recover the p=2 witness by K1 K0 inverse; reproduce the exact p=3 t=1/100 rotation with positive E and changed fourth covariance; verify exactly two legal p=2 completions; ensure empirical estimation never requires exact sample spectrum or probe-Gram equality. proposed_from.novelty_justification: AaltoLamolineGoncalves2022 assumes known propagated noise and exact state measurements; its whitening proof cannot decide whether an orthogonal completion admits a positive common measurement covariance after level reconstruction. The core adds blockwise two-probe Gram certificates after differencing, exact residual orthogonal fibers, joint stability, logarithm, Stein, and noise-positivity filters, a sharp three-versus-four snapshot frontier, an attained exponential legal fiber, and equality between information nullity and stabilizer dimension. WangEtAl2024 and QWENDY2025 use supplied state covariances satisfying homogeneous congruences and do not subsume this kernel.

seed_details.seed: Complete common-noise stabilizer fiber and the sharp three-versus-four snapshot frontier
seed_details.anchor: AaltoLamolineGoncalves2022, Theorem 2.1, proof on pp. 2--3, Introduction, and conclusion on p. 5
seed_details.opportunity: Replace known subtractable noise by one unknown common \(E\), difference covariances, and classify the resulting block Gram fibers together with every dynamical admissibility filter.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The covariance whitening begins with \(H_j=C_j-C_{j+1}\), not with a known-noise subtraction \(P_j-Q\); the Stein equation must later restore level information and test \(E\succ0\).
seed_details.red_team: Cynical objection: this is immediate from AaltoLamolineGoncalves2022 after replacing covariances by differences. Rebuttal: differencing only produces raw congruences; blockwise two-probe feasibility, residual \(O(k_\lambda)\) fibers, Stein reconstruction, strict \(E\)-positivity, logarithm filtering, and the three-versus-four frontier are not consequences of its known-noise uniqueness statement.

seed_details.seed: Certified recovery and labeling of every regular finite snapshot branch
seed_details.anchor: HauensteinSottile2012, Theorems 2 and 4, Algorithms in Section 2, Introduction, and Section 6
seed_details.opportunity: Turn a finite stabilizer fiber into a globally certified empirical estimator that returns every legal branch once and labels it continuously under perturbation.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Before applying \(\alpha\)-theory, eliminate redundant orthogonal variables and prove a sharp root count for a square zero-dimensional system; afterward certify semialgebraic stability, logarithm, Stein, and positivity filters.
seed_details.red_team: Cynical objection: alphaCertified already certifies all numerical roots. Rebuttal: it certifies supplied approximations to a square polynomial system and does not produce a complete snapshot-root system, prove exhaustiveness, handle stabilizer quotients, or certify the nonpolynomial logarithm cut.

seed_details.seed: Local minimax certification frontier at stabilizer collisions
seed_details.anchor: AndrewsCheng2012, canonical weak-identification setup on pp. 2155--2157 and main uniform-inference results
seed_details.opportunity: Index local experiments by Gram-collision rates and stabilizer tangent cones, and match lower and upper bounds for correct branch-count certification.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The scalar identification-strength parameter must be replaced by a matrix orbit normal form whose tangent cone changes with the collision path.
seed_details.red_team: Cynical objection: AndrewsCheng2012 already gives weak-identification robust inference for extremum estimators. Rebuttal: its canonical product parameterization does not encode orbit-type changes, path-dependent stabilizer tangent cones, or the loss of a discrete model count.

seed_details.seed: Minimal snapshots with jointly unknown process and measurement covariance
seed_details.opportunity: Determine the minimal transient marginal sequence identifying \(V,Q,E\) when neither nuisance covariance is known.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Adjacent differences no longer eliminate both \(Q\) and \(E\), so one must derive a lifted linear operator across several marginal recursions before any whitening.
seed_details.red_team: Cynical objection: KongEtAl2023 already gives rank conditions for identifying \(Q\) and \(R\). Rebuttal: its correlations come from a paired stationary series with known system matrices, whereas unpaired transient marginals contain no cross-time covariance and leave \(V\) unknown.

seed_details.seed: Sharp transition set under approximately common measurement noise
seed_details.anchor: Prior proposal \(\texttt{eid\_covshift\_profilequotient\_targets}\), technical diagnostic and reviewer strengthening path 1
seed_details.opportunity: Bound \(V\) sharply when \(E_k\) drifts within an operator-norm ball or a fixed low-rank model, with collapse to the exact common-noise fiber at radius zero.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Covariance differencing becomes \(H_j=V^j(\Sigma-V\Sigma V^{\mathsf T})(V^{\mathsf T})^j+(E_j-E_{j+1})\), so exact congruence is replaced by a structured perturbation set.
seed_details.red_team: Cynical objection: ordinary perturbation bounds already cover small changes in \(E\). Rebuttal: unknown adversarial drift changes the population identified set and requires endpoint attainability or matching inner and outer sets, not continuity of a point estimator.

seed_details.seed: Nonuniform snapshot schedules that remove continuous-time aliases
seed_details.anchor: DingQiuChen2009, continuous-time reconstruction theorem, Introduction, and conclusion
seed_details.opportunity: Give arithmetic and rank conditions on four irregular snapshot times that identify \(G\) and shared \(E\) without a principal-logarithm strip.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Intersect unequal-lag transitions learned indirectly from covariance congruences sharing one \(E\), instead of intersecting already identified discrete input-output models.
seed_details.red_team: Cynical objection: nonuniform sampling is a classical cure for aliasing. Rebuttal: the classical theorem starts from multiple identified discrete models, while unpaired marginals reveal only unequal-lag covariance congruences contaminated by a shared unknown additive covariance.

seed_details.seed: Centered-snapshot sign quotient and impossibility with arbitrarily many times
seed_details.opportunity: Characterize the residual \(V\sim -V\) and block-sign ambiguity when all mean probes vanish, and determine which sign branches remain continuous-time admissible even with arbitrarily many covariance snapshots.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The sign-selection equation from mean differences disappears, so identification must come solely from admissibility or must be stated as a quotient.
seed_details.red_team: Cynical objection: covariance congruences are obviously invariant to global sign. Rebuttal: the nontrivial part is the exact admissible quotient after real-logarithm and stability filters, but that narrower result is dominated by the full fiber theorem.

seed_details.seed: Optimal placement of a fourth destructive snapshot
seed_details.anchor: AaltoLamolineGoncalves2022, Section 3 sensitivity experiment and conclusion
seed_details.opportunity: Choose the fourth sampling time to maximize the smallest singular value of the moment map, with a certified design-efficiency bound under a fixed cell budget.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the qualitative comparison of adding time points by differentiating the unequal-time moment map and optimizing its information criterion over the schedule.
seed_details.red_team: Cynical objection: maximizing a condition number is routine optimal design. Rebuttal: a credible result needs a global certificate and must incorporate aliasing and common-noise identifiability; that theorem is not yet evidenced strongly enough.

seed_details.seed: Schrödinger-bridge objective with a complete common-noise branch certificate
seed_details.anchor: MorimotoKashima2025, Problems 4--6, Algorithms 1--2, Introduction, and Section 5
seed_details.opportunity: Constrain the bridge estimator to the exact compatible shared-noise branches and characterize when its global minimizers coincide with the population fiber.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Insert observation noise as a separate common covariance layer before alternating trajectory and process-noise updates, rather than treating observed marginals as state marginals.
seed_details.red_team: Cynical objection: this is merely another constraint in an EM-like algorithm. Rebuttal: equivalence would require a new population-minimizer theorem, but the exact fiber theorem is the logically prior and stronger angle.

proposed_from.literature_map: For the selected fiber seed, AaltoLamolineGoncalves2022 is the closest theorem and proof exemplar; WangEtAl2024 is the closest three-snapshot deterministic result and applied consumer; QWENDY2025 is the closest four-covariance algorithm; MorimotoKashima2025 and InoueEtAl2026 are the nearest optimization-based snapshot estimators; Blevins2017 supplies the aliasing benchmark. None of these sources models an unknown common additive measurement covariance and proves a necessary-and-sufficient stabilizer fiber. For certified finite branches, HauensteinSottile2012 certifies supplied polynomial roots, ChernozhukovHongTamer2007 gives criterion-set inference, and Drton2009 gives tangent-cone limits; none supplies complete empirical branch enumeration with logarithm and positive-definiteness filters. The collision-minimax seed was dropped after the deeper scan: AndrewsCheng2012 and Drton2009 provide weak-identification and tangent-cone machinery, but the scan did not yield a third close theorem or a defensible upper procedure matching the proposed lower frontier. The writing architecture follows AaltoLamolineGoncalves2022: destructive snapshots motivate moment equations, whitening exposes orthogonal freedom, an additional transition removes generic freedom, and the new shared-noise level filters complete the explanation. The method adaptation uses its eigenspace intertwining and orthogonal completion, Blevins2017 for alias selection, KoltchinskiiLounici2017 for covariance perturbation, and HauensteinSottile2012 only as the handle for the open global certification step.
